node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) negative reconstruction factor gate
node.closure: two normalized negative reconstruction templates with exact B and BC exceptional factor loci
node.statement: For every saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet, the twelve compatible negative internal-edge assignments form eight fixed-moving and four moving-moving templates. After normalizing the common endpoint to 2, their augmented reconstruction determinants factor exactly as a proved nonzero prefactor times A^2 B and A B C, respectively. The incidence identity z+1=(1+w)A/E and fixed-point-free label conditions force A nonzero. Thus negative candidates exist only on B=0, or additionally C=0 in the moving-moving template; those exceptional loci remain for the q-slice and full quotient gates.
